comment: (B) A LAND-SEARCH CRACK AT ITS QUEUE POSITION. T3, Evolving Wilds + a Forest, hand Llanowar Elves; the human queues 'crack the Wilds, then cast the Elves'. Before: the crack's position was the matched plan's searched land_search_act_slot (the trailing pass, after every cast, by default), whatever the queue said. Now it is a step of the "**" sequence.
